Both were checked out detached in fresh worktrees under /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-workingmyassof-satbank/9030c288-6222-49fa-a25a-6e6802e22cd3/scratchpad/verify_sys/ (since removed). (1) MCQ unchanged: PASS. I dumped every Item field except spr_mistakes for all 20 topic templates, seeds 0-80, three ways (default, fmt=mcq, fmt=spr where the template takes fmt): 5175 lines each on base and branch, and the non-spr_mistakes lines diff empty. Both sides fail on the same 9 cases (unknown_coefficient seeds 40, 42, 53, all three ways), so that failure predates the branch. purchase_solve and relation_pair take no fmt, so I also forced every scene (trivia, cinema, books, coins, tents, berries, grains, wire, shelf, ballot, survey) for seeds 0-80: diff empty. (3) spr_mistakes are real: FAIL. The value rules hold everywhere: no None, no value equal to the key, no duplicates; the audit enforces this and gridin_mistakes de-duplicates by value. But when I re-derived 15 random grid-ins by hand, several reasons do not produce their values. The branch passes each template's whole free-draw pool through with only a few per-draw drops, so pool entries built for a specific source item go out on draws where they are false.
- solve_standard seed 252 (-4x - 3y = -23, x + 5y = -7, x = 8): elimination leaves -17x = -136, yet pre_divide says 16 and over_divide says 4, both assuming a coefficient of 2. rhs1_half (-23/2) does not follow from its reason at all.
- solve_standard seed 297 (key 13): elimination leaves 106x = 1272, yet pre_divide is 26, over_divide 13/2 and rhs1_half 1/2.
- solve_substitution seed 104 (-8x + 2y = -14, y = 7x + 14, asks 4x, key -28):
  - slope1 (7), const1 (14) and recip1 (1/7) say "the first equation", but the values come from the second.
  - recip_sum (2/7) is the same reciprocal added twice.
  - neg_const2 (-14) claims it "dropped its minus sign", but the constant is +14.
  - sign_const (7/3) and subtract_sub (-7/11) are the wrong x, not the wrong 4x.
- solve_substitution seed 28: slope1 (8), const1 (-6), recip1 (1/8) and recip_sum (1/4) have the same first/second-equation mix-up.
- infinite_normalized seed 16 (y = (3/5)x + 3, asks m): clear_denominator is 9/5, but clearing gives 5y = 3x + 15, which never yields 9/5.
- purchase_solve trivia seed 189: price2 is -1 ("read ... out of the question"), but the question never prints -1. Trivia is grid-in only, so these reasons were never shown before, and they read "the first points an answer is worth" and "without using the points an answer is worths".
- purchase_solve cinema seed 107: half_count is 43/2, a ticket count, given as the answer to a dollars question. This is the same class as the "other" entry the builder dropped.
- These items check out: infinite_constant 176 and 329, infinite_normalized 126, no_solution_slope 149 and 265, unknown_coefficient 13, relation_pair 215 and 264.

Over seeds 0-200, a heuristic count of false entries:
- solve_standard: pre_divide/over_divide false in 384 of 384 entries and rhs1_half in 190 of 190, so all 200 grid-ins carry at least one false reason.
- solve_substitution: the "first equation" entries are false in 182 of 384, neg_const2 in 84 of 154, and sign_const/subtract_sub/numerator in 61 of 82 (the value is for the wrong variable); 135 of 200 grid-ins are affected.
- infinite_normalized: clear_denominator is false whenever the question asks for m (44 of 74 entries, 44 of 200 grid-ins).

The same pool entries already appear in free-draw MCQ, so the underlying errors are older than this branch. The builder's report says it dropped mistakes "whose wording is false for that draw" but kept these. The prose gate reads only item.reasons (satbank/check.py:244), never spr_mistakes reasons, so the gate cannot catch any of this.

(4) Gate: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m satbank check --topic systems_of_linear_equations prints PASS, with 5,993 items re-derived by the audit.

(5) Coverage: every template with a mistakes pool that can return a grid-in is covered. The only grid-in return without spr_mistakes is no_solution_gathered, which has no pool, so leaving it out is correct. purchase_solve two_stores and relation_pair ballot/survey never make grid-ins. In relation_pair, the `() if s["link"] == "difference"` branch can never run for a grid-in, because only wire and shelf (both "sum") make grid-ins.

defects.what: pre_divide (key*2) and over_divide (key/2) assume the elimination coefficient is 2, and rhs1_half (c1/2) does not follow from its reason on a free draw. All three reach every solve_standard grid-in. Seed 252 re-derives to -17x = -136 but names 16, 4 and -23/2; seed 297 re-derives to 106x = 1272 but names 26, 13/2 and 1/2.
defects.fix: Add pre_divide and over_divide to the grid-in drop unless the leftover elimination coefficient (the one _story computes) is ±2 and the question asks for the variable that elimination isolates. Always drop rhs1_half for grid-ins, or keep it only for the source items it was written for.

defects.what: _sub_pool takes `first` as whichever equation is solved. When e1 is in standard form, slope1, const1, recip1 and recip_sum say 'the first equation' but use the second, and recip_sum adds the same reciprocal twice. slope1 also names the y coefficient when the first solved equation is solved for x. neg_const2 says 'dropped its minus sign' when e2's constant is not negative. sign_const, subtract_sub and numerator give the wrong value of the substituted variable, not the asked y, sum, diff or kx. Seeds 104 and 28 show all of these; across seeds 0-200, 135 of 200 grid-ins carry at least one.
defects.fix: Extend `drop`: drop slope1, const1, recip1 and recip_sum unless e1 is the solved equation; also drop slope1 when that equation is solved for x, and recip_sum when e2 is not solved. Drop neg_const2 unless e2 is solved with a negative constant. Drop sign_const, subtract_sub and numerator unless the question asks for the variable left after substitution.

defects.what: When the question asks for m, clear_denominator is key*m.numerator. For y = (3/5)x + 3 that gives 9/5, but clearing gives 5y = 3x + 15, so the reason never produces 9/5. This affects 44 of 200 grid-ins.
defects.fix: Pass drop=('clear_denominator',) to gridin_pool when shape is slope_intercept and ask == 'm'.

defects.what: Trivia is grid-in only, so these reasons were never shown before this branch. With per='points an answer is worth' they read 'read the first points an answer is worth out of the question' and 'without using the points an answer is worths'. price2 names -1 as a number read out of the question, but the question never prints -1, and total_over_price2 (-t) builds on that -1. The prose gate never reads spr_mistakes reasons, so none of this is caught.
defects.fix: For the trivia scene, drop price2 and total_over_price2, and either drop price1, total_over_price1 and no_price or reword that scene's `per` so the strings read correctly. Trivia makes no MCQ, so MCQ output cannot change.

defects.what: half_count names n/2, a ticket count, as the answer to a question asking for dollars (seed 107 names 43/2 for a $345 key). This is the same mismatch for which the builder dropped 'other' and the off-by-one entries.
defects.fix: Add 'half_count' to the spend_first drop tuple.
